name: Canon Boundary Guard
summary: Codex skill that keeps project evidence, chat context, operator instructions, working hypotheses, and model assumptions in separate cognitive layers.

layers.name: Shaping
layers.description: Conversation material not approved for persistence.

layers.name: Authorized Delta
layers.description: Operator-approved material for the current turn before persistence.

layers.name: Agent Control
layers.description: Instructions that shape agent behavior, not project content.

layers.name: Codex Instruction Chain
layers.description: AGENTS guidance and runtime instruction-chain material.

layers.name: Model Prior
layers.description: Unverified model memory, assumed conventions, or unstated framework behavior.
